Role: PLAYER\_ROLE\_DAMAGE · Primary stat: STAT\_STRENGTH

## Description

```text
### OVERVIEW
Raise your spear and fight for glory!

As a Hoplite, your raw combat prowess allows you to weild a twohanded spear and a shield simultaneously, providing both deadly offense and incredible defense.

Strike foes in a flurry of blows with your spear, or toss javelins from afar to bleed them dry.

Hoplites build up Combo Points to unleash devastating shield slams and dominate their enemies.

### ROTATION
2. HOPLITE  (Legendary: Hoplite)  -  MELEE DAMAGE
----------------------------------------------
Mail, polearm + shield, thrown weapon. Stats: Strength first.
Battle Stance turns on the Hoplite abilities: Thrust (for Sinister Strike),
Shield Strike (for Shield Slam), Javelin (for Heroic Strike), Flurry of Spears
(for Siegebreaker). Pet: a Winter Wolf, given with the Legendary (no taming).

In combat:
 1. Battle Stance, if missing
 2. Windfury Weapon on the polearm, if missing
 3. Call the wolf (create it the first time, revive it if dead)
 4. Pain Suppression on itself, at critical health
 5. Shield Bash, to interrupt
 6. Kick, to interrupt, only when no other enemy stands within 10 yards of the caster
 7. Intercept, then Heroic Leap, when the target is out of melee range
 8. Misdirection on the tank
 9. Hard fights: Bloodlust, Death Wish, Hunger For Blood (once the target bleeds
    from Impaled), Shattering Throw
10. Bladestorm, with 3+ enemies close by
11. Bloodrage, only when it is not already active
12. Rampage, if missing
13. Victory Rush
14. Execute, on a low target
15. Devastate, when Sunder Armor has less than 4 seconds left
16. Sweeping Strikes, with 2+ enemies close by
17. At 5 combo points: Flurry of Spears with 2+ enemies, otherwise Shield Strike
18. Colossus Smash
19. Javelin, to keep Impaled on the target
20. Javelin, whenever it is ready again (Colossus Smash resets it)
21. Devastate, taking turns with Thrust until Sunder Armor has 5 stacks
22. Thrust (combo point builder)
23. Demoralizing Shout, if missing
24. Windfury Totem, if not down

Out of combat: Battle Stance, Windfury Weapon, the wolf, Blessing of Might on itself,
Blessing of Kings on the others, Commanding Shout, Trueshot Aura, Aspect of the Beast.
```
